Tom —

Appreciate the heads up and congrats on the volume ramp. Summary of practical options below; I attached a short draft amendment and a mutual action plan for clarity.

1) Immediate uplift (single amendment)
   - Add committed units (tokens/hour equivalent) effective on PO receipt.
   - Discount on uplift tiered by size: 0-30% extra = 5% discount; 30-100% extra = 10% discount; 100%+ = 15% discount.
   - Co-term: we can align the amendment to your June 30 end date with prorated billing for the shortened period.

2) Staged top-up (voucher-style installment)
   - You purchase a voucher for future committed units that vest monthly. Pricing band slightly higher (approx +2% to list) but spreads billing.

3) Burst + true-up (no long-term commit)
   - Short-term capacity add with higher unit price and a month-end true-up. Good if growth is uncertain.

Operational notes:
   - We typically require a countersign or PO + signed amendment for mid-contract committed changes.
   - Legal changes are minimal; we can keep the EULA the same and add an amendment that specifies uplift units and co-term mechanics.

If you share target uplift % and preferred invoicing (one-time vs monthly amortized), I can build a pricing grid and a recommended invoice schedule.

Attached: BlueMark_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, Uplift_Amendment_draft_20260810.pdf

Best,
